newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bahrain emir in UAE to see president.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain emir in UAE to see president.

text.p: Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa arrived in the United Arab Emirates on Thursday to meet President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan who has returned home after surgery in the United States.
The official Emirates news agency said Sheikh Isa will "congratulate" Sheikh Zaid on his successful surgery.

Sheikh Zaid returned on Wednesday after being absent since July 1 when he left for private visits to Morocco and Geneva. He underwent surgery on a vertebra in his neck at the Mayo Clinic in Minnesota on September 27 followed by a period of convalescence in Spain and Morocco.
